title: The complete slab-two full-Fisher sublevel is excluded above the slab-three threshold
method: K1796's exact odd-Hermite Bernstein bank excludes the slab-two complement of its seven retained leaves. K1804 proves those leaves are exactly one rectangle. K1808's whole-line Cauchy witness is strictly above the comparison threshold throughout that closed rectangle, so it covers interiors, faces and corners simultaneously.
scope_guard: This is a complete slab-two value exclusion, not an assertion that no stationary point exists there. Global optimizer promotion still requires complete slab-three uniqueness/value control and its exposed boundary.
